scope: nominal build-box necessary conditions for the unseparated acquired source
scale_authority: owner confirmation, not independent specimen metrology
metric_domain: original vertices referenced by original nonzero-area triangles; no geometry repair
pair_rule: largest Euclidean distance among the six axis-extreme vertices; lower bound only, not global diameter
decision: pair distance greater than box diagonal plus margin excludes any rigid placement of the current input; otherwise no orientation-independent fit decision
original_pose_test: coordinate spans at most box dimensions; permits translation, no rotation, no support/plate/keepout allowances
